title: pm: the post-merge governed audit has no owner or schedule, and shows a seat landing through the low-risk arm as a breach
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (follow-up F of a Fable evaluation of the low-risk Tier H delegation that Leehom asked for, write-up `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/review/33531-delegation-review.md`, read on PR #33531 head `e2b1cabc`; rated not blocking the merge of #33531). `reach:` AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14 names the post-merge audit as the compensating control for seat-landed merges, but no one runs it and its report cannot tell an arm landing from a violation.

**What is wrong.** `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` is a manual, report-only script with no schedule. It classifies merges by path, so a skills PR the seat lands through the low-risk arm shows as "Tier H merged without approval", indistinguishable from a breach (record 6886787995 nit N3 on PR #33531, not carded until now).

**What lands.** The audit lists arm landings apart, and for each one checks a same-head at-tier PASS record exists. A weekly owner runs it (a patrol step or a scheduled workflow, whichever the fleet's rules allow) and the result is posted where the maintainer reads it.

`scripts/pm/**`, possibly `.github/workflows/**` (governed); `skip-changeset`. `Clause-②: no`. Blocked-by: #33501 (PR #33531). Dedupe: `is:issue check-governed-merges audit weekly` → none. **New.**
